description: This file defines the FixedSizeBuffer class, which manages a contiguous block of memory, allowing segments to be allocated and reset. It is part of the Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically within the Common namespace for pooled cache resources.

classes.name: FixedSizeBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a fixed-size byte buffer, allowing segments to be allocated and reset.

methods.name: FixedSizeBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with a specified size in bytes.

methods.name: TryGetSegment
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a segment of the buffer of a specified size.

methods.name: OnResetState
methods.description: Resets the buffer's state, clearing the used portion.
